title: Linux pilot v1: native Ubuntu 24.04 x86_64, pinned Claude Code, original reviewed filesystem and Git servers, explicit enforcement
claim: Selects the supported v1 pilot configuration over the existing installed entry points and states what is conditional or excluded. It grants no authority, adds no capability and never certifies acceptance; qualification evidence is separate and bound to exact source.

platform.supported: native Ubuntu 24.04 x86_64, ordinary non-root user

enforcement.shadow: outside v1; never selected and never reported as protection

status_model.enforce: Reported only when a run of this exact selection answers an authenticated status query that requires enforcement.
status_model.shadow: Not part of this scope. A daemon that is not enforcing fails the enforce-requiring query and is reported unavailable.
status_model.unavailable: A run or selection exists but cannot protect now: stale selection, drifted scope or an unanswered query.
status_model.unqualified: No exact-source acceptance is claimed by this scope; Missing external acceptance remains NOT_READY, not a release approval.

refused_operations.why: The selected read-only profile has no dispatch for effect tools; policy additionally hard-denies the recognized effect classes before execution.
Media reads have no result profile in the selected registry; unsupported by the selected profile.
Known classifier-coverage gap: the call is unknown, policy Ask, and the collector refuses it. It is not an authorized operation.
Git mutation and branch enumeration have no dispatch in the selected read-only profile; policy additionally hard-denies the recognized effect classes.
